_comment: ROBOD (Room-level Occupancy and Building Operation Dataset) point -> CAMBER Role mapping, one file per room (combined_Room<N>.csv). Rooms 1-2 are lecture rooms on fan-coil units; rooms 3-5 are served by 100% outdoor-air (dedicated outdoor air) handlers through a VAV box per room -- the data descriptor states the incoming air's CO2 equals outdoor -- so their supply airflow (supply_air_flow, m3/h) is the room's outdoor-air flow and maps to oa_airflow; the VAV box damper is damper. Room 3 has its own air handler; rooms 4 and 5 share one (every air-handler column is identical in the two files). temp_setpoint is the room cooling setpoint (Singapore, cooling only) -> cool_sp. The fan-speed columns are in Hz (0-50 Hz drives), not percent, so they are not mapped as a speed: the ingest derives a 0/1 fan status from speed above 1 Hz. The cooling-coil valve COMMAND is mapped, not the position feedback, which reads 1.7-7.8 points above the command when it is 0 (see the entry's data issues). offcoil_air_temp / offcoil_temp_setpoint (the coil-leaving control point), energy counters (kWh per 5-minute interval), pressures, VOC, PM2.5, illuminance, Wi-Fi and occupant counts have no CAMBER role here. occupant_presence (camera ground truth, 1 exactly when occupant_count > 0) is the occupancy role; rooms 1-2 export it without the '[binary]' unit suffix. Units (metric) are declared on the catalog entry. Dataset: ROBOD (CC-BY-4.0), doi:10.1007/s12273-022-0925-9.
